test.create_query: CREATE TABLE merge_src (sid UInt64, ts DateTime64(3), value Float64, v1 Float64, v2 Int32, v3 Int32, v4 UInt8, v5 Float32, host LowCardinality(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (sid, ts) SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1

CREATE TABLE merge_dst (sid UInt64, ts DateTime64(3), value Float64, v1 Float64, v2 Int32, v3 Int32, v4 UInt8, v5 Float32, host LowCardinality(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (sid, ts) SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1

CREATE TABLE merge_dst_batch (sid UInt64, ts DateTime64(3), value Float64, v1 Float64, v2 Int32, v3 Int32, v4 UInt8, v5 Float32, host LowCardinality(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (sid, ts) SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1, merge_use_batch_sorting_queue = 1

CREATE TABLE merge_src_str (sid String, ts String, value String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (sid, ts) SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1

CREATE TABLE merge_dst_str (sid String, ts String, value String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (sid, ts) SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1
